}}'''Erim''' is the clan chief of the [[Chareen]] [[Aiel]]. He is of the White Mountain sept.{{ref|{{twotc}}, Erim}}

==Appearance==
He is an older man with his red hair starting to go white, and with green eyes.

==Activities==
He is present at [[Alcair Dal]] when [[Rand al'Thor]] declares himself ''[[Car'a'carn]]'' the same time [[Couladin]] does.{{ref/book|4|57}} After this he takes his clan to [[Rhuidean]] while waiting for all the rest of the clans to gather there.{{ref/book|5|2}}

He leads his Aiel clan when he is sent to the [[Plains of Maredo]] when Rand gathers a massive army in preparation for the attack on [[Illian]].
